title: Sampling rate
text: The buoy shall sample pH, dissolved oxygen, turbidity and temperature at least once every 10 minutes.
rationale: Ten minutes resolves tidal-cycle variation with margin.
complianceEvidence: HS-TR-0001 v1.0: longest observed interval 9 min 58 s.

checks.text: Is 10 minutes enough to catch a discharge event?
checks.reply: Yes: regulator guidance treats 15 minutes as the minimum useful resolution.
